Coram : C.T. RAVIKUMAR*, SANJAY KAROL
Issue for Consideration Whether the signatory of a cheque authorized by the Company is a drawer and whether such a signatory could be directed to deposit any sum out of the fine or compensation awarded by the trial Court u/s.148 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, as a condition for his conviction u/s.138 of the NI Act.
